description: This file defines the User class within the Opencart system, handling user authentication, session management, permissions, and user data retrieval.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user in the Opencart system, managing login, logout, permissions, and user data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the User object, loads user data if session exists.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user with username and password, updates session and permissions.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears user session and resets user data.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has a specific permission.

methods.name: isLogged
methods.description: Returns whether the user is currently logged in.
